name: angular-native-federation-banking-mfe
description: Enterprise Banking Micro Frontend MVP using Angular 18+ Standalone, Signals, and Native Federation

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/shell-host install && npm --prefix apps/mfe-accounts install && npm --prefix apps/mfe-transfers install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n SHELL,ACCOUNTS,TRANSFERS -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix apps/shell-host start" "npm --prefix apps/mfe-accounts start" "npm --prefix apps/mfe-transfers start"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix apps/mfe-accounts run build && npm --prefix apps/mfe-transfers run build && npm --prefix apps/shell-host run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/shell-host test -- --watch=false && npm --prefix apps/mfe-accounts test -- --watch=false && npm --prefix apps/mfe-transfers test -- --watch=false
